description: Makes a contact list on the Contacts page, or answers the live one with that name. Add people to it with edit_contacts (op add_to_list). Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: create_contact_list
title: Make a contact list
